coordinates.selection: Only scanner/terminal identifiers and numeric XYZ facts. No descriptions, story text, website code, images or geometry copied.

validation: Runtime target must match a catalog coordinate within 2 m. Native confirmation additionally requires actual pin/hash/position/objective link; unknown or changed sites use a separately owned quest-style fallback. No game-build completeness claim.
